## Dispatch order — R34

Claimed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`. Branch: **`claude/issue-6342-source-file-link-population`**. Assignee is this seat's shared identity — the claim is this comment plus the session ID.

### The ruling you are executing (triage, 2026-08-25T14:59:32Z — verbatim)

> Triage: `pm:queue` + `domain:devx`, Task, S/M — `check-doc-links` can already decide a GitHub blob URL but its population filter is `.md`/`.mdx` only, so a dead link written in a `.ts` file (objectui#6275's, since fixed) survives. Fix is population widening in the gate: admit doc-link-bearing comments in source files (measure the population size first and report it — if the widened sweep floods with historical debt, freeze it in a reasoned baseline per ratchet convention rather than skipping). Gate surface ⇒ devx@objectui lane.

⚠️ One stale line in that ruling, corrected: it notes *"the devx@objectui seat is currently vacant (#5748)"*. It is not — this seat has been active all day and has landed 16 cards. The card queued correctly regardless.

### ⭐ Step 1 is the census, and it decides the shape of everything after it

The card is explicit and honest that **the blast radius has not been measured**, and ⛔ tells you not to scope as if it had been. So:

**Count, repo-wide, how many `github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/(blob|tree)/main/…` URLs live in `.ts`/`.tsx` (and any other source extension you find them in), and how many are already dead.** Report both numbers before proposing anything.

The card states the fork the census decides, and I am adopting it as the ruling:
- **small count** → repairing them by hand and leaving the gate alone may be the proportionate answer;
- **large count** → widening the population is the fix — ⚠️ but that means the gate starts parsing **source files**, a real change to its runtime and its false-positive surface, ⛔ **not a one-line regex edit**.

⛔ **If the census says "small", say so and hand back rather than widening the gate anyway.** Doing the bigger change because you already started is the failure mode this card was written to prevent. A card that ends in "measured, and the proportionate answer is N hand fixes" is a successful run.

### If you do widen it

- Triage's ratchet instruction is binding: **if the widened sweep floods with historical debt, freeze it in a reasoned baseline** per this repo's ratchet convention — ⛔ never skip, never lower the bar to green.
- ⚠️ **The false-positive surface is the real risk.** `check-doc-links.mjs:154` already resolves this URL shape; the danger is what *else* a source-file sweep picks up. Sample what your widened population admits and report the noise, not just the signal.
- ⭐ `stripCode()` exists because a command example must not be misread as a broken link (#6280 measured this). Source files are *all* code — think about what the analogous protection is before you point a markdown link parser at them.

### Two-direction proof, whichever way it goes

If the gate changes: plant a dead `blob/main/` URL in a source file, run, record **RED**; restore via `git checkout HEAD -- <absolute path>` under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, prove the restore by `git hash-object` and an empty `git diff HEAD`, re-run **GREEN**. ⛔ A widened population that cannot be shown to catch the thing it was widened for is not a fix.

⚠️ Every zero-hit needs a **control term** — a string you know is present, matched by the same sweep. This lane has been defeated three times today by readings taken without one, twice by me.

### Do not inherit

- ⛔ **#6280 is landed and is not this card.** It corrected stale *prose describing* the scan surface. This is a **capability gap in the gate itself** — every widening #6280 lists (#4148, #4938, #6026) added more *markdown* roots and none crossed the `.md|.mdx` extension filter. ⚠️ If you widen the population, the surface descriptions #6280 just rewrote become stale again — check them and update them in the same PR, since that page and its lists are pinned.
- The line numbers on the card (`:650`, `:154`) are from before today's five edits to that area; ⛔ re-read on your own HEAD.

### Constraints

- ⛔ **Worktree-first**: `git worktree add ../objectui-6342 -b claude/issue-6342-source-file-link-population main && cd ../objectui-6342 && pnpm install`.
- ⛔ **Never `git stash`** — the stack is shared across every worktree of this repo.
- ⛔ **Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.**
- ⛔ Do not set `domain:*` or type labels; file findings **unassigned**.
- ⚠️ Run the **whole** `scripts/__tests__` tree.
- Changeset required. Open the PR as **draft**; this seat arms it.

### Reporting

Structured JSON report. **Lead with the census** — both counts, the commands, the control terms — because everything after it is conditional. Then which fork you took and why, and if you widened: the noise sample, the baseline (if any) with its reasoning, and the two-direction proof.

## Review — ACCEPT (PR #6428), and ⭐ the census refuted this card's own model

Reviewed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`, R34. Report returned **`premise_still_valid: false`** — correctly.

### What the census found, and why it changes the answer rather than sizing it

138 self-repo `blob|tree` URLs repo-wide; 21 outside the gate's population; **16 of those are the gate's own deliberately-dead fixtures**, 2 are the literal ellipsis in its own hint text, and **3 are genuine authored links in product source — 2 of them dead.** Small fork taken, per this card's own rule and the dispatch order: two hand repairs, gate untouched, widening handed back.

⭐ **But the important finding is not the size — it is that the card's model is half wrong in a way that changes the answer.** This card says the gate *"is not missing the ability to judge that URL, it is missing the file."* Measured:

- the extractor is `MARKDOWN_LINK_RE = /\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)/g` (`:518`) and ⛔ **never extracts a bare URL**;
- all 3 genuine source links are **bare**, and both dead ones live inside `console.warn` **string literals**, not docblocks;
- ⛔ so widening the extension filter alone **would not have caught #6275's link either** — the worked example this card was built on.

⭐ And the real mechanism, which neither the card nor triage had: **116 of 116** self-repo URLs inside the current markdown population are `[x](y)` and **0** are bare; in source files **3 of 3** are bare. The two populations *spell links differently*. The extension filter was never the only thing in the way.

⭐ That claim was **proven rather than argued** — a faithful simulator (same `stripCode()`, same regex, same self-repo arm) over a source file carrying both spellings reports the markdown one and **not** the bare one, while the same simulator finds 4 on the gate's own fixture file, so it demonstrably works. A simulator that found nothing would have proven nothing.

### The two repairs are better than "make the link resolve"

- `Registry.ts:228` → re-pointed at the live `/docs/guide/plugin-development#namespaced-registration`, verified with **the gate's own resolver**, plus a dead control (`/docs/guide/definitely-not-a-real-page-xyz`) confirming the resolver reports dead.
- `validation-engine.ts:411` → the `See:` line **dropped entirely**, because the deleted guide covered namespaces and lazy field registration and ⚠️ **never documented conditions at all** — so that pointer was *misdirected as well as dead*, and the message already carries a complete before/after inline. ⭐ Noticing that a dead link was also pointing at the wrong thing is the difference between repairing a URL and repairing the sentence.
- ⛔ Neither can use #6275's immutable `git show SHA^:PATH` form, and the reason is right: these are **console messages read by app developers who have only the npm package**.

### Noise sample, as ordered — and it is what prices the open question

194 findings over 3,764 source files, **none a genuine defect**: 135 from the gate's own test file, and **48 of 257 extractions are not links at all** but TypeScript matching the regex (`'n.title, { description: n.message }'`, `'javascript:alert(1'`). ⛔ No baseline proposed, and correctly so — the ratchet instruction's precondition is not met, because the flood is fixtures and non-links, **not historical debt**. Freezing 194 fixture strings would not be a ratchet.

### The open question is now a decision card

Filed as **#6430**, with the census, the refutation, the noise measurement, four-axis analysis and a recommendation of **A** (close on the census), with **C** (bare-URL-only check, signal 3 / noise 2) as the only shape worth costing if the capability is wanted. ⭐ **B is the shape triage imagined and the one the measurement rules out** — 194:2, and its natural false-positive defence (comment-only masking) is *mutually exclusive with the defect*, which lived in string literals.

### One instrument note worth keeping

⚠️ `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/core' test` **exits 1 by design** in this repo (#3378's guard against package-dir vitest false-green). The dev identified that as a **refused invocation, not a red test**, and re-ran correctly from the repo root. ⛔ Reading that exit code as a failure is how a good run gets reported as broken.

### Disposition

⛔ Arming PR #6428 on **every** check green. The repairs are correct under **all three** options on #6430 — a dead pointer is wrong regardless of whether a gate ever learns to see it — so they do **not** wait on that decision.

## Closing — ⛔ **on a maintainer ruling that has named this card since 2026-08-27**, not on this seat's judgement

`domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_013VGeMu3p6qEFWR6K6GGLaW`, R59.

### The authority, quoted

objectui#6430's maintainer ruling (`os-zhuang`, 2026-08-27, adjudication session `session_01DKWDdUJ2XNRESVVWUvcpnh`, verbatim 「以上同意」), **Option A**, closing paragraph:

> **Follow-through for the devx lane: #6342 closes on this census per its own fork rule** ("small count ⇒ hand repair"), with a pointer here; PR #6428's hand repairs stand under this ruling as they did under every option.

⇒ ⛔ this is **not** a self-adjudication. The ruling names this card, names the outcome, and assigns the follow-through to this lane. Executing it is the follow-through; ⛔ declining to would be leaving a ruled card open.

### ⛔ Why this card has nonetheless sat in `pm:queue` for 14 days

The 2026-08-31 triage unlock moved it `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` on this reasoning:

> 本卡的 `Blocked-by:` 目标**已全部关闭**,阻塞比阻塞方活得久 … ⇒ 声明的前置条件已兑现 ⇒ 解除,回 `pm:queue`。

⭐ **That read the blocker's STATE and not the blocker's RULING.** objectui#6430 did not merely close — it closed *by deciding this card's outcome*. A mechanical "blocker closed ⇒ back to queue" is correct for a card whose blocker was a dependency; it is **wrong** for a card whose blocker was a **decision about the card itself**, and it silently converted "ruled and finished" into "waiting to be dispatched".

⚠️ ⭐ **This is the same trap this seat walked up to earlier today** and recorded on the seat post: eight cards in this lane have all their named blockers closed and were deliberately **not** unlocked, because *closed blockers are necessary, not sufficient*. objectui#6342 is the proof that the caution is warranted — the failure already happened here, 14 days ago, and nobody noticed because the card looked healthy.

### The census condition, verified on `origin/main` @ `2b67a62fd7` before closing

The ruling's premise was 2 dead links, hand-repaired in PR objectui#6428. ⛔ Verified rather than assumed:

| leg | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR objectui#6428 on `main` | ✅ `3c2b6f7677` — *fix(core): repoint two deprecation warnings off the deleted MIGRATION_GUIDE.md (#6428)* |
| `MIGRATION_GUIDE.md` as a tracked file | ⛔ **not present** — consistent with "the deleted" |
| references to `MIGRATION_GUIDE` anywhere in the tree | **1 file**, and it is `.changeset/6342-dead-migration-guide-pointers.md` — the changeset **describing** the repair, ⛔ not a live pointer |
| **CONTROL**, same command, a doc that does exist | `CONTRIBUTING` → **56** files ⇒ the reader discriminates, so the `1` is a reading and not a grep that finds nothing |

⇒ the repairs are on `main`, the dead pointers are gone, and the census the ruling rests on still holds.

### ⛔ What is NOT closed by this

`check-doc-links` still does **not** judge links in source files, **by ruling**. Option **C** — a bare-URL-only self-repo checker over source files — is recorded in objectui#6430 as *"the only priceable shape if this class ever recurs at scale"*, with its reopening evidence named: a measured accrual well above the current ~one link per several thousand files. ⛔ That is a **new card with that measurement attached**, ⛔ never a reopening of this one.

**Half-state note**: this card also carried a stale assignee for 19 days (`pm:queue` + assignee, from the R34 dispatch whose PR merged 2026-08-26). Repaired earlier this round at `5667379233`; recorded here so the close-out is complete rather than tidy.
